drop: Drop a PPT, PPS, POT, DPS, or DPT file here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your presentation stays in this browser. No uploads or remote document resources.
invalid: Choose a readable PowerPoint 97–2003 PPT, PPS, POT, or compatible WPS DPS / DPT file. The document may be damaged or use an unsupported format.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This presentation contains unsupported or missing content. Save a self-contained copy in your presentation application and try again.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page, close other tabs, or try another current browser.
fidelity: Slides keep their saved order, size, and orientation, including hidden slides. Supported text remains selectable; pictures and graphics are included. OCR is not added.
limitations: Animations, transitions, audio/video playback, speaker notes, comments, macros, and digital signatures are not preserved or verified. Linked document resources are not loaded.
protected: Password-protected presentations are not supported. Save an unencrypted copy in your presentation application and try again.
layoutNotice: Fonts and advanced effects may differ from the original application. Check every slide in the PDF preview before downloading.
engineDownload: The first conversion downloads about 90 MB of engine and font files, which your browser may cache. Your presentation is never uploaded.
